a3_descriptive.strata: near |d| < 20, tail |d| >= 2q, middle between; sides d < 0 / d > 0, the node d = 0 in neither; error = recovery_e2 - recovery_g2 on the recovery grid (801 points at q = 50, 881 at q = 60), max r/s on the verifier grid of the tier

bootstrap_scheme: fresh numpy.random.default_rng(seed) per (q, statistic); idx = rng.integers(0, n, size=(n_boot, n)); 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles of the resampled mean (or median)
